content.comment_body: Hi, I'm encountering an issue where my [product_name] does not display options for starting or programming commands. How can I resolve this? I've attached a photo of the [product_name] display.

The reason is that your [product_name] is currently in operating mode, which restricts the menu and disables options like 'start / stop.' To access these features, you need to switch to ADMIN mode using the required password. By default, the password is '[product_name]' (without quotation marks). Refer to the attachment for guidance.

analysis.insight_summary: The user was unable to access start and programming commands on the [product_name] display due to restricted access in operating mode. Switching to ADMIN mode using the default password restored full menu access. This situation shows that users may find it confusing to navigate access controls and different operational modes on the hardware interface.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to directly access and utilize start and programming commands from the hardware interface without encountering restrictions.
